role: response-independent site universe, public proxy geometry, and recorded-imaging site-week effort

proxy_coordinate_rule.interpretation: midpoint of public-release obscuration bounding box; not the exact camera coordinate

effort_endpoint_universe.eligible_media_rule: media row must join uniquely to a visit and to an eligible monitoring-station registry row, have parseable start_date, and not carry a source sb_exclude=true token
effort_endpoint_universe.calendar_week_rule: week_start = media.start_date minus weekday offset, Monday-based Gregorian date
effort_endpoint_universe.eligible_site_week_rule: at least one eligible label-free media row exists for that site and week
effort_endpoint_universe.endpoint_interpretation: future response is recorded American-marten detection conditional on at least one camera media event in the site-week; no-media weeks are outside the endpoint rather than treated as non-detections

structural_geometry.thresholds_are: response-blind analyst-choice structural scales, not calibrated biological dispersal distances

profile: eligible site-week count by calendar year
eligible site count by calendar year
temporal_profile_only.future_split_rule: freeze chronological calibration/heldout years only after this response-independent effort profile and before any biological response header or row access
